command: set -euo pipefail; ADB=/opt/homebrew/bin/adb; echo CURRENT_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo ORIGIN_MAIN=$(git rev-parse origin/main); MDNS="$("$ADB" mdns services)"; ENDPOINT="$(printf '%s\n' "$MDNS" | awk '/adb-RFCT70L7E8J/ && /_adb-tls-connect\._tcp/ {print $3; exit}')"; test -n "$ENDPOINT"; "$ADB" connect "$ENDPOINT" >/dev/null; test "$("$ADB" -s "$ENDPOINT" get-state)" = device; echo WIFI_ENDPOINT=$ENDPOINT; echo '--- PACKAGE ---'; "$ADB" -s "$ENDPOINT" shell dumpsys package link.localclimate.app | grep -E 'versionName=|versionCode=|lastUpdateTime=' | head -10 | tr -d '\r'; APK_PATH="$("$ADB" -s "$ENDPOINT" shell pm path link.localclimate.app | sed -n 's/^package://p' | head -1 | tr -d '\r')"; test -n "$APK_PATH"; TMP="$(mktemp -d)"; trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT; "$ADB" -s "$ENDPOINT" pull "$APK_PATH" "$TMP/installed.apk" >/dev/null; mkdir -p "$TMP/installed"; unzip -qq "$TMP/installed.apk" 'assets/public/*' -d "$TMP/installed"; INST_SIG="$(cd "$TMP/installed/assets/public" && find . -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 shasum -a 256 | shasum -a 256 | awk '{print $1}')"; echo INSTALLED_WEB_ASSETS_SHA256=$INST_SIG; git fetch origin main >/dev/null; git worktree add --detach "$TMP/main-src" origin/main >/dev/null; cd "$TMP/main-src"; corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; corepack pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile build >/dev/null; MAIN_SIG="$(cd apps/mobile/dist && find . -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 shasum -a 256 | shasum -a 256 | awk '{print $1}')"; echo MAIN_WEB_ASSETS_SHA256=$MAIN_SIG; if [ "$INST_SIG" = "$MAIN_SIG" ]; then echo PHONE_MATCHES_MAIN_WEB_ASSETS=YES; else echo PHONE_MATCHES_MAIN_WEB_ASSETS=NO; fi
